name: Profit Labels
summary: Profit Labels is a utility indicator/EA for MetaTrader 5 that displays profit information directly on the chart as visual labels. It helps traders monitor open position profits in real-time without switching to the trade panel, providing at-a-glance P&L visibility overlayed on the price chart.
summary_zh: Profit Labels是一个MetaTrader 5工具类EA/指标，直接在图表上以可视化标签形式显示持仓盈亏信息。它帮助交易者实时监控持仓利润，无需切换到交易面板，在价格图表上提供一目了然的盈亏可见性。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略类程序，而是一个可视化工具，用于在图表上标注当前持仓的盈亏信息。它不包含任何入场或出场逻辑，不会自动开仓或平仓，因此没有策略概念、入场条件或出场条件可言。仓位管理和资金管理在此工具中不适用，因为它不执行任何交易操作。其核心功能是读取当前账户的持仓数据，计算每个持仓或整体持仓的浮动盈亏，并将结果以标签形式显示在图表界面上。工具可能支持按品种、按方向分别统计盈亏，也可能包含总盈亏汇总显示功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but rather a visualization utility that labels profit and loss information directly on the chart. It contains no entry or exit logic and does not automatically open or close positions, so there are no strategy concepts, entry conditions, or exit conditions to analyze. Position sizing and money management are not applicable since the tool executes no trades. Its core functionality reads current account position data, calculates floating P&L for each position or the overall portfolio, and displays the results as labels on the chart interface. The tool may support profit/loss breakdown by symbol or direction, and may also include total portfolio P&L summary display functionality. It serves purely as a monitoring aid to enhance a trader's situational awareness.

parameters.name: ShowPositionProfits
parameters.description: 是否显示每个持仓的盈亏
parameters.description_en: Whether to display profit/loss per position

parameters.name: ShowPips
parameters.description_en: Whether to display profit/loss in pips

parameters.name: ShowCurrency
parameters.description_en: Whether to display profit/loss in currency

parameters.name: Corner
parameters.description: 标签显示在图表的哪个角落

pros: 直观地在图表上显示盈亏信息，无需切换窗口即可掌握持仓状态
可自定义标签位置、颜色和字体大小，适应不同交易者的视觉偏好
实时刷新盈亏数据，帮助交易者快速做出持仓管理决策
pros_en: Intuitively displays P&L info on the chart, monitoring positions without switching windows
Customizable label position, color, and font size to suit different visual preferences
Real-time P&L refresh helps traders make quick position management decisions
cons: 作为工具类程序，不提供任何交易功能，功能较为单一
标签可能遮挡价格图表的关键区域，影响技术分析判断
缺乏历史盈亏统计和更高级的绩效分析功能
cons_en: As a utility, provides no trading functionality with relatively limited feature scope
Labels may obscure key areas of the price chart, potentially interfering with technical analysis
Lacks historical P&L statistics and more advanced performance analytics features
improvements: 增加历史交易盈亏统计和绩效图表分析功能
添加标签拖拽功能避免遮挡关键价格区域，并支持多时间框架盈亏对比显示
improvements_en: Add historical trade P&L statistics and performance chart analysis features
Add label dragging to avoid obscuring key price areas, and support multi-timeframe P&L comparison display

risk_points: 工具本身不执行交易操作，无直接资金风险
依赖账户持仓数据的实时读取，若数据延迟可能导致显示不准确
risk_points_en: The tool itself executes no trades, posing no direct financial risk
Relies on real-time position data reading; data latency could cause inaccurate display

summary_en: Profit Labels is a utility indicator/EA for MetaTrader 5 that displays profit information directly on the chart as visual labels. It helps traders monitor open position profits in real-time without switching to the trade panel, providing at-a-glance P&L visibility overlayed on the price chart.
